messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's current action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, following the demonstration in the reference video. Use the reference video only for the action. Keep the person's identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select the version from before the first camera change was made and apply the following edit to that version: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: change the person's current action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, following the demonstration in the reference video. Use the reference video only for the action. Keep the person's identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in an open plaza, then raises one arm to touch or scratch the back of his head before lowering it and standing still.","camera":"Static medium-long shot from a low, slightly side-rear angle, keeping the character centered.","clothing":"Dark long-sleeved top with a small light-colored emblem on the back, dark track pants with a thin light stripe down the side, and dark shoes.","hair_color":"White or very pale pink, glowing under the scene lighting.","hairstyle":"Short, spiky hair swept upward.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build, shown mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"A futuristic outdoor plaza at night with a glossy reflective floor, a domed glass building with glowing teal rings on the left, and a tall building with lit windows on the right."},"uncertain":["Exact hair color (white vs. pale pink) is ambiguous due to the colored lighting.","The character's face is not clearly visible, so facial features are unclear."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output character now lowers the head and raises one hand to the face/forehead area around the middle of the clip, then lowers the arm and stands still. The character, clothing, futuristic plaza, lighting, and static camera remain essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, using the reference only for motion while preserving identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera.
uncertain: The exact hand contact point is partly obscured by the head and angle, so whether it rests precisely on the forehead rather than near the face or back of the head is not fully certain.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly cropped or reframed compared with the source, with black bars visible at the top and bottom in some frames.
